title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

ISO ); Familiarité avec les procédures administratives de sanction; Expérience dans un des secteurs visés par l'annexe de la loi du 5 mai  sur la résilience des entités critiques. Profil Compétences techniques Assurer les activités de prévention et de sensibilisation promues par le Centre; Compétences de prendre en charge la population cible du Centre; Déterminer l'indication pour la forme de prise en charge la plus inclusive possible; Conseiller et guider les équipes pédagogiques et les membres de l'ESEB dans le cadre de la prise en charge spécifique de la population cible du CDM; Assurer un examen approfondi pour contribuer à l'établissement d'un diagnostic spécialisé; Accomplissement des actes éducatifs, rééducatifs et thérapeutiques par l'adaptation des techniques et des objectifs à la spécificité du travail en classe, en groupe et en individuel; Gestion du dossier électronique de l'élève: recueil de l'anamnèse, les tests, les bilans, les rapports de professionnels, le journal de bord, etc; Evaluation régulier/ière du succès des mesures éducatives, rééducatives et thérapeutiques. Réadaptation des techniques et du projet en cas de besoin. Compétences comportementales Etre une personne ouverte et engagée; Avoir le sens de responsabilité; Savoir travailler de façon autonome; Avoir un sens relationnel développé avec les enseignants, élèves et parents d'élèves; Etre flexible et savoir collaborer avec les équipes pédagogiques de l'école; Savoir s'adapter à des horaires de travail selon les besoins du service; Savoir communiquer et coopérer avec un nombre élevé de partenaires dans le respect du droit à la discrétion de la personne aidée et des exigences déontologiques du métier ; communication constructive et visant une solution. Atouts Capacité de conseiller les parents sur les interventions spécifiques telles que des examens médicaux, des interventions psychologiques, sociales, etc., desquels peuvent bénéficier leur enfant. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. title: Développeur Innovation - Technologies émergentes & IA (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Dans le cadre de sa transformation numérique, l'administration judiciaire recrute un développeur full stack pour le service de gestion des projets informatiques. Le service gestion des projets informatique s'organise sur le modèle de la Digital Factory, et comporte plusieurs programmes de digitalisation articulés autour d'équipes Scrum, et un pôle transverse abritant les centres de compétences partagées (architecture d'entreprise, DevOps, change management.) et un laboratoire d'innovation. Au sein de l'Innovation Lab, vous contribuerez à l'identification, l'exploration, au prototypage et à la validation rapide de solutions innovant/antes à forte valeur pour les métiers de la Justice. Vous interviendrez sur des proofs of concept (POC), prototypes et démonstrateurs, avec un objectif clair: expérimenter rapidement, démontrer la valeur métier, préparer l'industrialisation des solutions lorsque les résultats sont concluants. L'Innovation Lab a pour ambition de: Expérimenter des technologies émergentes et leurs usages au service des métiers de la Justice, notamment dans les domaines de l'intelligence artificielle, de l'automatisation, du low-code/no-code et des nouveaux services numériques; Produire des POC et démonstrateurs rapidement industrialisables; Collaborer à l'industrialisation des solutions validées; Connecter l'administration judiciaire à l'écosystème luxembourgeois de l'innovation; Organiser et soutenir des ateliers, hackathons et moments d'échange avec les métiers; Diffuser durablement une culture de l'innovation et de l'expérimentation dans l'administration. Le développeur Innovation Lab pourra intervenir sur des sujets tels que: Intelligence artificielle appliquée (agents, assistants, NLP, classification, recherche augmentée, automatisation intelligente, intégration de services d'IA générative); Développement de prototypes et démonstrateurs s'appuyant sur des technologies émergentes; Outils low-code / no-code; Automatisation de processus; Blockchain / registres distribués; Nouveaux usages numériques, interfaces innovant/antes et expérimentation orientée utilisateur; Méthodes d'innovation collaborative, design participatif, hackathons et innovation ouverte. Missions En tant que développeur au sein de l'Innovation Lab, vous serez impliqué dans l'identification, la conception, la réalisation et l'évaluation de prototypes technologiques. À ce titre, vous serez amené à: Analyser la faisabilité technique de cas d'usage innovants proposés par les métiers ou identifiés par l'Innovation Lab; Concevoir et développer rapidement des POC, prototypes et démonstrateurs, en privilégiant une approche pragmatique orientée validation de la valeur métier; Évaluer des technologies émergentes et comparer plusieurs approches de mise en œuvre; Développer des composants backend, frontend, API ou automatisations nécessaires aux expérimentations; Concevoir et intégrer des solutions s'appuyant sur des services d'intelligence artificielle, des modèles existants ou des plateformes spécialisées afin de répondre à des besoins métier concrets; Contribuer à l'intégration de solutions innovant/antes dans l'environnement technique existant, dans une logique de future industrialisation; Participer à la qualification technique des solutions en matier/ière de sécurité, performance, interopérabilité, maintenabilité et exploitabilité; Collaborer étroitement avec les chefs de projet, analystes, architectes, experts infrastructure, experts externes et parties prenant/antes métier; Travailler avec les architectes et les développeurs des autres programmes de digitalisation afin de préparer et mettre en œuvre les projets visant à industrialiser les POC validés; Contribuer à la définition des conditions de passage d'un prototype vers une solution industrialisable, en veillant à l'alignement avec les standards d'architecture, de sécurité, d'exploitation et d'intégration de l'administration judiciaire; Documenter les choix techniques, les résultats de tests, les limites observées et les recommandations d'industrialisation; Contribuer à la capitalisation des apprentissages issus des expérimentations; Assurer une veille technologique active et contribuer à l'évaluation de nouveaux outils, frameworks, services ou plateformes susceptibles d'apporter de la valeur aux métiers; Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de développement, de prototypage, de tests et d'innovation responsable; Développer et maintenir certaines solutions innovant/antes dont l'Innovation Lab garde le full ownership. Profil Compétences techniques Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que développeur; Maîtrise de Python, notamment pour le prototypage rapide, l'automatisation et l'intégration de services d'intelligence artificielle: Maitrise...

title: Gestionnaire Contrôle & Analyse de dossiers (m/f) (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Caisse pour l'avenir des enfants est en charge du paiement des prestations familiales, du congé parental et effectue également l'adhésion et la gestion du chèque-service accueil pour travailleurs non-résidents qui souhaitent inscrire leur enfant auprès d'un service d'éducation et d'accueil. Le service Contrôle intervient comme fonction de deuxième ligne de défense au sein de la Caisse pour l'avenir des enfants. Ses activités s'inscrivent dans un référentiel de contrôle interne basé sur le cadre COSO et reposent sur plusieurs contrôles clés réalisés de manier/ière régulier/ière, notamment dans les domaines des contrôles de conformité, des enquêtes sur dossiers complexes, de l'entraide administrative ou de certains contrôles à composant/ante financier/ière. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un Gestionnaire Contrôle & Analyse de dossiers (m/f) pour renforcer l'équipe et contribuer aux activités de contrôle, d'analyse et de documentation des dossiers traités par le service. Contribution à l'évolution du dispositif de contrôle: Participer à la documentation et à l'amélioration continue des contrôles réalisés par le service; Contribuer à la structuration et à l'harmonisation des méthodes de travail et de documentation; Participer à des réflexions visant à renforcer l'automatisation de certains contrôles ou analyses; Contribuer à l'évolution des outils et pratiques du service dans une logique d'efficacité et de traçabilité. Profil Compétences techniques Excellente capacité d'analyse et esprit structuré; Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aptitude à synthétiser des situations complexes; Rigueur méthodologique et sens de l'organisation; Capacité à travailler sur des dossiers nécessitant des interactions multiples; Aisance dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs institutionnels; Sensibilité aux approches structurées, à la documentation et à l'amélioration continue des processus; Intérêt pour les aspects juridiques liées au droit de la sécurité sociale; Excellentes capacités orales et rédactionnelles des langues luxembourgeoise, allemande, française et anglaise. Atouts Expérience professionnelle d'au moins 5 années dans le domaine de la sécurité sociale ou dans un environnement administratif comparable; Bonne connaissance du fonctionnement des institutions de sécurité sociale luxembourgeoises; Une expérience dans des activités de contrôle, d'analyse de dossiers ou de conformité constitue un atout important. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. title: Business Resilience Officer (f/m/d)
description:
Business Resilience Officer (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

As Business Resilience Officer, you will be part of the Clearstream Securities Services (CSS) Business Resilience function within the Independent Business Risk and Control (IBRC) area, supporting the governance of first line of defence (1LoD) risk and control practices, with a focus on strengthening the effectiveness, quality and efficiency of the internal control environment.

In this role, you will support the team in connecting processes, risks, controls, findings, incidents, claims and remediation activities into a single risk-resilience cycle. You will contribute to a robust, proportionate and fit-for-purpose Internal Control System (ICS), while building your analytical skills and progressively adopting data, automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities under the guidance of more experienced colleagues.

Your responsibilities:

• Support ICS quality and efficiency: Perform analysis on the quality, adequacy, completeness and consistency of CSS processes, risks and controls, and support continuous improvements towards proportionate, balanced and efficient ICS key controls.
• Support audit and supervisory remediation: Assist in the coordination of regulatory onsite inspections and in the tracking of significant internal, statutory and regulatory findings, including support to evidence collection, Corrective Action Plan (CAP) documentation and remediation progress monitoring.
• Assist external assurance coordination: Support ISAE 3402 and SOC 2 audit work, including preparation of documentation, drafting of observations, follow-up on improvement measures and liaison with the external auditor under the supervision of more senior team members.
• Contribute to integrated control reporting: Support connecting-the-dots analysis and reporting across internal and external findings, Self-Identified Issues (SII), claims and goodwill, and incidents, helping to provide a comprehensive view of control maturity, failure events and actionable remediation; contribute to the Annual Management Report on Internal Controls.
• Support SII and CAP lifecycle management: Assist in the identification of SIIs and associated CAPs, help maintain the inventory, monitor remediation progress and support transparent reporting.
• Contribute to the risk-resilience cycle: Support the integration, rationalisation and elevation of the risk-resilience cycle by helping to challenge business practices and supporting the simplification and automation of processes, including the adoption of AI tools and techniques.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Banking, Finance or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in the financial services industry is preferred, ideally within banks, financial market infrastructures, regulatory bodies or supervisory authorities. A basic understanding of the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model and first line of defense (1LoD) risk and control responsibilities is expected.
• Initial exposure to or keen interest in at least one of the activities listed under your responsibilities, such as ICS quality, operational risk and controls, audit or supervisory remediation, external assurance, SII and CAP management, integrated control reporting, incidents, claims or resilience-related governance. Prior internship or traineeship experience in a related area is a plus.
• Ability to perform structured analysis, produce clear and accurate deliverables, follow up on tasks reliably and seek guidance proactively. Willingness to learn, ask questions and accept constructive feedback.
• Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarise information clearly and contribute to the preparation of materials for management review.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail, curiosity, pragmatism and a willingness to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. A structured approach to problem-solving is valued.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel, familiarity with SharePoint and collaborative document management, ability to prepare clear presentations, and openness to learning and using AI-based tools and automation in daily work.
• Fluency in spoken and written English is required; German and French are an advantage.

title: Kapitän (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:


Chemgas Barging S.à r.l., Luxembourg
Inland shipping


Transporting gas on inland waterways in an efficient, reliable and safe manner. That is what we do and what we are good at. Chemgas is the market leader in the transport of pressurized liquefied gases on inland waterways. Our colleagues are committed to this 24/7, all year round. You too can contribute to this! We are looking for a captain for our inland shipping fleet.


What will you do?

As a captain, you provide motivating leadership and this enables you to ensure that our crew and the ship function optimally. You know how to guide your colleagues in the right way, ensure the pleasant working atmosphere on board and promote growth. In the position of captain, you are responsible for the safe, optimal and proper execution of the transport. You carry out your work within the framework of our ship policy and, where necessary, you contribute to improvements. In addition, safety is of paramount importance to you. You help ensure that all (safety) protocols and guidelines on board are complied with.


What ambition do you contribute to?

Chemgas is not standing still, and neither is our inland shipping branch. Our modern and well-maintained fleet is always evolving. We invest a lot of time and energy in new construction and conversion projects. In recent years, our fleet has been expanded with a number of new ships. New construction projects are also planned for the coming years and we are once again rejuvenating our inland shipping fleet. As a result, we are looking for additional talent to strengthen our team.

Partly because of our innovative ships, we strive for the highest achievable. Efficient gas transport for our clients is central and our employees are paramount. With your expertise, you can make an important contribution to this objective.


Are you looking after the vacancy?

You have an eye for safety, the environment and health and you also like to work in a team.


We also ask the following:

You are in possession of a Rhine patent up to at least Mannheim and you can also sail this route independently;
You are willing to obtain your patent up to Iffezheim;
ADN base and willingness to obtain ADN gas;
Radar patent;
VHF certificate;
EU Qualification Certificate.

What do we offer?

Is sailing on the wide rivers and canals in your blood? Are you also looking for a versatile job in inland shipping? Then Chemgas offers you many opportunities for a challenging career. Our inland vessels operate from Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp to Basel. We invest a lot in our employees and our ships. Our fleet is always evolving and equipped according to the latest techniques and innovations. Thanks in part to our motivated crew, there is a positive and enthusiastic atmosphere on board our ships. Expertise, dedication and discipline are paramount. On our inland shipping fleet, we only sail with Dutch-speaking colleagues. Chemgas is a committed company where a lot is possible and your work is appreciated. We focus on internal growth and therefore invest a lot of time in good training and advancement opportunities.

Our barge fleet operates from Luxembourg. Our sailing leave schedule consists of one week on board and one week at home, but two weeks on and two weeks off is also possible. On board you walk in a system of 8 hours on/8 hours. On an annual basis, you have the choice to work 24/28, 25/27 or 26/26 weeks. Would you like to know more about our terms of employment or do you have questions about this? Do not hesitate to contact us and we will be happy to help you!

title: Finance Manager, EU AMXL (m/f)
description:
Finance Manager, EU AMXL
Job ID: 10507726 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The EU AMXL Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to own the financial strategy and controllership within the AMXL Fulfillment space. Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) manages the end-to-end fulfillment of heavy and bulky products — a strategic, high-growth segment for Amazon in Europe, operating across multiple countries with diverse operational and legal frameworks.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a finance leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and shape decisions that affect the long-term economics of the EU AMXL network. The successful candidate will own financial planning and controllership for their area end-to-end, partner directly with Director-level operations and network leaders, and drive strategic analyses that inform multi-year network topology, rate, and investment decisions. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with data, build mechanisms that scale, and bring clarity to ambiguous, complex problems.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Finance & Decision Support:

- Own the financial plan (OP1/OP2/QxG) and long-range outlook for your area, independently building models and scenarios that inform network strategy.
- Lead high-impact analyses (e.g., network topology, rate setting, cost-to-serve, business cases) and present recommendations directly to senior leadership.
- Challenge operational and business partner assumptions with data, providing disruptive ideas where the numbers warrant it.

Business Partnering & Influence:

- Act as the trusted finance partner to Director-level operations, planning, and network leaders, influencing strategic decisions without direct authority.
- Navigate across organizations (e.g., Network, Transportation, Supply Chain, Accounting, Procurement) to align stakeholders and drive outcomes.
- Translate complex financial trade-offs into clear narratives for both Finance and non-Finance senior audiences.

Controllership & Operational Excellence:

- Own financial reporting integrity for your area (month-end close, variance analysis, cost controls), routinely delivering error-free outputs.
- Proactively identify control gaps and risks driven by business, regulatory, or operational change, and design solutions.
- Invent and institutionalize mechanisms (dashboards, automated reporting, planning tools) that scale across the team and network.

Leadership & Force Multiplication:

- Mentor and coach junior analysts, raising the bar on analytical rigor across the team.
- Contribute to the broader Finance community through best-practice sharing, hiring, and development initiatives.
- Identify and drive process improvements that remove bottlenecks and improve decision-making speed across the org.

A day in the life

No two days look the same in AMXL Finance. You might start the morning partnering with an operations leader to pressure-test a network change, spend mid-morning deep in a cost-to-serve model that will shape next year's topology, then present your findings to senior leadership in the afternoon. You'll move fluidly between the detail (validating a cost driver, reconciling a variance) and the big picture (where should we invest, what's the long-term economic story). You'll be the financial voice in the room — challenging assumptions, surfacing risks early, and helping the business make smarter, faster decisions. Expect autonomy, real ownership, and the space to build mechanisms that outlast any single planning cycle.

About the team

The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.

You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.

We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.

title: Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (m/f)
description:
Financial Crime Prevention Analyst / Investigator (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1145

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

One of the key missions of the Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function is to conduct independent and risk-based investigations to protect the Bank's assets, reputation, and integrity, while ensuring compliance with Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) regulatory requirements.

As a Financial Crime Prevention Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in the detection, assessment, and investigation of potential financial crime risks. This position requires strong regulatory knowledge, excellent interpersonal skills, a genuine investigative mindset, and the ability to navigate complex situations involving AML/CFT, reputational, tax, and other financial crime-related risks.

Your next challenge:

• Review, assess, and investigate cases involving potentially suspicious activity and financial crime concerns.
• Conduct enhanced due diligence, background checks, adverse media reviews, and open-source intelligence research on prospects, clients, counterparties, and transactional parties.
• Analyze customer profiles, account activity, transaction flows, corporate structures, and supporting documentation to identify red flags and assess potential risks.
• Document, structure, and synthesize investigative findings, presenting well-supported assessment to the Compliance Incident Committee (CIC).
• Gather and compile all relevant information required for the preparation and submission of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
• Draft high-quality SARs/STRs based on comprehensive assessments of client activity, transactional behavior, and overall risk exposure.
• Act as a key liaison with the FIU and support responses to regulatory inquiries and requests.
• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Front Office, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to support investigations and manage financial crime risks.
• Keep abreast of evolving financial crime typologies, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Your skills:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Financial Crime Compliance, AML/CFT Investigations, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience dealing with financial crime matters, suspicious activity investigations, and high-risk client relationships.
• Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime typologies, and investigative methodologies.
• Knowledge of banking activities, legal structures, financial products, and client relationships is considered a strong asset.
• Previous experience in Front Office, Credit, Client Relationship Management, or other banking functions would be highly valued.
• Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
• Knowledge of any additional European language would be considered an asset.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Strong investigative mindset with a genuine interest in conducting research and uncovering complex financial crime patterns.
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to connect information from multiple sources and formulate reasoned conclusions.
• Strong synthesis and report-writing abilities.
• Curiosity, resilience, sound judgment, and the confidence to challenge when required.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work autonomously while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of integrity, discretion, and accountability.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

title: Project Manager - Digital Banking and Mobile Application (m/f) - SP
description:
Description:

Context

For one of our clients, a leading financial institution, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager - Digital Banking & Mobile Applications to manage the delivery and continuous improvement of customer-facing mobile banking solutions.

The role combines end-to-end project management with strong coordination across business, IT, UX/UI, security, compliance, and external technology partners. You will ensure that digital banking initiatives are delivered within the agreed scope, budget, and timeline while meeting customer experience, security, regulatory, and operational requirements.

Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, developers, testing teams, and vendors, you will support the full delivery lifecycle - from project initiation and requirements definition through testing, deployment, and post-release stabilization.

Key Responsibilities:

- Digital Banking Project Delivery
- Lead digital banking and mobile application projects from initiation through successful implementation.
- Define and manage project scope, objectives, planning, budget, timelines, resources, risks, dependencies, and delivery roadmaps.
- Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, and technology partners throughout the project lifecycle.
- Ensure projects are delivered in line with business expectations, technical constraints, and operational requirements.

Mobile Application Delivery:

- Manage the delivery of new mobile banking features, customer journeys, and application enhancements.
- Coordinate Product Owners, business analysts, UX/UI specialists, architects, developers, and testing teams.
- Maintain alignment between business requirements, solution design, development activities, testing, and delivery priorities.
- Coordinate mobile application releases, transition into production, post-release monitoring, and stabilization.
- Governance & Stakeholder Management
- Establish appropriate project governance, reporting, and decision-making processes.
- Prepare and maintain project plans, steering committee materials, status reports, risk registers, and delivery documentation.
- Provide clear visibility on project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies.
- Facilitate communication across business, IT, operations, compliance, and senior management, while supporting timely escalation and issue resolution.
- Coordinate third-party providers and monitor the quality and timely delivery of their commitments.
- Quality, Risk & Regulatory Alignment
- Ensure digital banking solutions meet internal quality, security, and operational standards.
- Coordinate testing activities, including system integration testing, User Acceptance Testing, and business validation.
- Monitor defects, delivery risks, and remediation actions through to closure.
- Ensure relevant regulatory, data protection, cybersecurity, and accessibility requirements are integrated into the delivery process.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of digital delivery methods, governance processes, and ways of working.

Required Profile:

- Proven experience as a Project Manager, Digital Project Manager, or IT Project Manager within complex technology environments.
- Strong experience delivering digital platforms, customer-facing applications, or mobile applications.
- Experience managing projects across the complete delivery lifecycle, from initiation and planning through implementation and stabilization.
- Good understanding of mobile application development, digital product delivery, and Agile or hybrid methodologies.
- Strong project governance, planning, risk management, and reporting capabilities.
- Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and external technology providers.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
- Fluent in French and English.

Résumé français:

Gestion et coordination de projets de transformation IT et digitale auprès des clients de BTO Research. Analyse et formalisation des besoins, définition et suivi des plans projets, coordination des différentes parties prenantes métiers et IT, suivi des risques, dépendances, budgets et délais, préparation du reporting projet et des comités de gouvernance. Participation aux activités de conseil de BTO, à la structuration des livrables clients et à l'application des méthodologies et standards internes de gestion de projet.

title: Senior Consultant in Valuation Assurance - Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) (m/f)
description:
Senior Consultant Valuation
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1702399
  
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

At EY, we support you in achieving your unique potential — both personally and professionally. We give you stretching and rewarding experiences that keep you motivated, working in an atmosphere of integrity and teaming with some of the world's most successful companies. And while we encourage you to take personal responsibility for your career, we support you in your professional development in every way we can. You enjoy the flexibility to devote time to what matters to you, in your business and personal lives. At EY you can be who you are and express your point of view, energy, and enthusiasm, wherever you are in the world. It's how you make a difference.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant FAAS // Valuation - September 2026, your responsibilities will be to perform and carry out valuation analysis and reviews of a wide spectrum of assets (Private Equity, Private Debt, as well as Intangible assets) in assessing the reasonableness of valuations and financial models in the context of financial reporting and assurance related engagements.

• Perform valuations for alternative investments e.g. Infrastructure, Private Credit, Private Equity or Venture Capital.
• Lead, coordinate, and develop a team of Assistants, ensuring effective execution of engagements.Build and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel and assess client satisfaction.
• Apply deep understanding of complex valuation concepts to real-world client scenarios.
• Coordinate on-site fieldwork at client locations, liaising with other departments to ensure smooth audit delivery.
• Responsible for contributing to the delivery of one or more processes, solutions and/or projects by delivering agreed activities, applying judgement, and selecting appropriate methodologies to inform recommendations, considerate of success criteria, barriers, risks, and issues.
• Accountable for meeting own targets which impact the immediate team.May help coordinate the work of junior colleagues or team members.
• Meets performance objectives and metrics set locally (client service, quality and risk management, sales and business growth, solution development and teaming etc.)
• Anticipate risk, team effectively across EY and identify opportunities to enhance trust, focusing on:Overall quality, building deep relationships, and value creation through independence and client understanding.
• Account strategy and delivery, maximizing the possibilities from data and technology

Skills and attributes for success

• You have 2 – 3 years of experience in a similar role (e.g. Transaction services, M&A, Private Equity, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance);
• Graduate from an economics, business and/or management school with a focus in finance.
• Excellent academic background.
• Advanced theoretical and practical knowledge of valuation principles and techniques (income, market approach) with regards to business valuation.
• Strong analytical skills, problem solver, detail-oriented, entrepreneurial, autonomous and enjoy working in a multi-cultural environment.
• Being flexible when adapting to changing client needs and market conditions.
• Ability to manage multiple threads of tasks and / or engagements.
• Proven ability to mentor and guide junior team members and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
• Sound knowledge of recognized valuation guidelines, such as IPEV guidelines.
• Sound knowledge of industry software and tools (i.e. S&P CapIQ, and/or advanced Excel modelling).
• Perfect command of English, both written and verbally, within a professional services business environment.
• Receptive feedback and reflection to develop strengths and address developmental areas.
• Seeks and embraces opportunities to gain exposure to a wide spectrum of reviews.
• Command of French or German language is an asset, and additional language would be considered as a plus.
• PC proficiency including MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Professional qualification in progress (CFA, CAIA, ACA, RICS…) is a plus.

What we offer you

• As Senior, you will lead a multicultural team of high performing individuals
• Enhance your technical expertise and leadership skills through tailored development programs designed to meet the demands of tomorrow.
• Expand your horizons by collaborating with diverse teams across the globe, gaining insights from professionals with varied backgrounds and perspectives.
• Define your purpose and contribute to building a better working world, both within EY and in society at large.
• Receive comprehensive training and coaching to solidify your technical skills and pursue professional certifications (ACCA/IRE).

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Legal and Transactions Officer (m/f)
description:
Legal and Transactions Officer - Private Equity

The individual will be responsible for servicing a portfolio of real estate and private equity funds, as well as other investment structures. The individual will liaise with financial controllers and legal counsel at fund managers, third parties, and other external advisors as necessary to ensure the smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met.

Specific responsibilities include client onboarding, active involvement in transactions (e.g. fund closings, acquisitions, disposals, capital calls, distributions, etc.), preparation of board packs, coordination of board and shareholder/investor meetings, preparation of minutes, creating and updating statutory registers (e.g. directors, limited partners, and shareholders) and other transfer agency functions. The individual will be required to attend client board and other meetings.

The individual will work within a small client team, reporting daily to the relevant Langham Hall client manager. The candidate will be expected to interface at a senior level with clients to problem-solve and proactively deliver our services.

The successful candidate will be involved in developing other team members to provide a quality, client-focused service.   The candidate will have an understanding of the Luxembourg legal, tax, and regulatory regimes applicable to private equity and real estate funds, as well as other relevant structures.  

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the first point of contact for the clients in relation to all corporate/ legal matters for a varied portfolio of alternative investment funds and SPVs
• Responsible for training and development of junior team members in the team through training and coaching
• Maintain control over delegated work by discussing the timeframe and deadlines, agreeing on scheduled checkpoints at which you will review project progress, making adjustments where necessary, and allocating time to review all submitted work.
• Responsible for client onboarding, bank account openings and incorporation of funds and SPVs
• Preparation and review of service level agreements, appointment/resignation of directors and other corporate matters
• Able to interpret constitutional documents (e.g. articles, LPA) of a client structure and liaise with other service providers (lawyers, tax advisors) for any queries that may arise
• Responsibility for fund closings, including the holding of board meetings, collation of subscription agreements and KYC and communication with investors to confirm the closing has taken place.
• Review of legal documents in relation to acquisitions, disposals, restructuring transactions, liaising with client and third parties as necessary
• Actively provide client leadership by identifying situations requiring decisions for board and shareholders meetings (in particular transactions, execution of documents, approvals)
• Liaison with third parties and internally for company set up, liquidation, company secretarial and compliance issues
• Responsible for the maintenance of accurate investor and company records (static data, shareholder/ partners registers), process all investor changes/transfers thereon and ensure any regulatory and statutory filings are completed promptly
• Process and coordinate day-to-day fund operations, including capital calls and distributions.
• Responsible for ensuring all documents and company records are organised and filed appropriately (both electronically and hard copies).

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• University degree preferably in law, finance or business administration.
• 1-2 years' experience in a similar position gained within a corporate services provider or law firm in Luxembourg.
• Self-starter, highly organised and able to work independently and part of a team.
• Able to multitask and prioritise day-to-day work to meet client and business needs.
• Flexible, able to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
• Good knowledge of the AML and KYC requirements in Luxembourg.
• Excellent organisational skills and interpersonal skills for a high degree of client interaction and the promotion of client interaction within the business.
• Excellent communication skills in English, with French and/ or German an advantage (both written and oral).

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional qualification (e.g., ILA Cosec Pillar 1/ICSA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

The Senior Valuation Officer plays a key role in overseeing and supporting the valuation framework for UCITS and AIF structures managed or supervised by Waystone. In addition to providing high-quality valuation oversight and technical expertise, the role contributes actively to the commercial enablement of the Waystone service by supporting client engagement, model design, and the articulation of Waystone's valuation capabilities to internal and external stakeholders. The role operates at the intersection of technical valuation, regulatory compliance, and client-facing service delivery.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Assist in leading and overseeing the valuation process for a portfolio of alternative investment funds, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with relevant regulations and internal policies.
• Act as a senior valuation subject-matter expert in support of client, commercial, and product initiatives, including RFPs, client due diligence, and service design discussions.
• Participate in client and prospect discussions to explain valuation frameworks, governance, and methodologies in a clear, structured, and credible manner.
• Support the onboarding of new funds and mandates, including documenting, reviewing, and validating valuation frameworks, methodologies, and governance arrangements in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders.
• Contribute to the enhancement and ongoing maintenance of valuation policies, procedures, and internal controls in line with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
• Monitor regulatory developments affecting valuation activities and industry standards and contribute to impact assessments and implementation actions.
• Conduct valuation analyses across a broad range of asset classes, including liquid instruments, complex financial instruments, and illiquid assets, and support the preparation of valuation reports and committee materials for internal and external stakeholders.
• Coordinate and support valuation-related audits, regulatory queries, and due diligence exercises carried out by auditors, regulators, depositaries, and investors, in support of the Head of Valuation.
• Identify and support opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and enhancement of valuation methodologies to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability of the valuation function.
• Collaborate with internal commercial, client service, and product teams to ensure valuation considerations are appropriately articulated.
• Promote a culture of quality, accountability, regulatory awareness, and commercial mindset.
• Act as a trusted internal point of reference on valuation-related topics across the organisation.

REQUIREMENTS

• You hold a University Master's degree in Economics, Finance or Mathematics. A specialization in quantitative economics will be considered as an advantage.
• 7+ years experience in valuation within the asset management industry is preferred, with a focus on alternative investment funds.
• Strong understanding of valuation principles, methodologies, and techniques for a wide range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, derivatives, and alternative investments.
• Strong knowledge of quantitative finance, risk management methods and financial instruments.
• Profound knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to valuation of AIFMDs and UCITS.
• Professional certification preferred, CFA, FRM CAIA, CFI certifications or any valuation certificate.
• Good analytical, organizational, writing and communication skills.
• Able to work both independently. Recognized team player.
• Fluent in English; any other language will be considered as an asset.

Job Description:

Husky is accelerating its use of AI, analytics and data platforms to improve decision speed, operational efficiency, customer experience and cost transparency. We are seeking a Director of Data & AI who combines hands-on technical depth, product-minded delivery, business partnership and pragmatic governance.

The role leads the global Data & AI Office and works in a hub-and-spoke model with business leaders, AI Champions, process owners, architecture, cybersecurity, finance and operations. The Director is accountable for turning data and AI opportunities into measurable business outcomes while ensuring data quality, security, compliance, responsible AI and ITGC-aligned delivery.

This is not a pure policy or reporting role. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating close to the technology, challenging complexity, enabling rapid pilots, scaling what works and building the standards required to make AI safe, repeatable and enterprise-ready.


Responsibilities:

Delivery, Product and Business Value

Build and run a portfolio of AI, analytics and data products, prioritizing initiatives with clear business value and measurable outcomes.
Lead rapid experimentation and scale successful pilots into stable, reusable enterprise capabilities.
Partner with business leaders and process owners to identify where AI and trusted data can remove friction, improve decisions or redesign work.
Define value cases, adoption metrics and benefit-realization methods for AI and data initiatives.
Create reusable delivery patterns for AI agents, analytics products, predictive models, knowledge solutions and automation.

Hands-On Technical Leadership

Remain close to the technical work: review architectures, data models, integration approaches, AI agent designs, prompt/RAG patterns, ML use cases and platform decisions.
Guide teams on modern cloud data platforms, data warehousing, data products, analytics engineering, Python/SQL practices, MLOps and GenAI solution design.
Work with architecture, cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to ensure AI/data solutions are secure, scalable and operationally supportable.
Challenge over-engineering and promote pragmatic designs that can deliver business value quickly without creating long-term technical debt.

Data Strategy, Governance and Quality

Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy aligned with business priorities and AI readiness.
Establish data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, metadata practices and trusted-data principles across the organization.
Improve data quality, lineage, accessibility and consistency across core business domains and platforms.
Ensure compliance with applicable data protection, security, privacy, retention and industry requirements.

AI Governance and Responsible AI

Lead practical AI governance that enables responsible innovation rather than slowing delivery.
Define standards for AI use-case intake, risk assessment, knowledge-source validation, model/agent review, access control, monitoring and periodic review.
Ensure AI initiatives meet responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, IP protection, auditability and ITGC expectations.
Partner with Legal, HR, Compliance, Cybersecurity and business leaders on sensitive AI use cases and risk-based controls.

Operating Model, COE and Adoption

Lead the Data & AI Office as a center of excellence that provides standards, enablement, reusable components and delivery support.
Operate a hub-and-spoke model with business AI Champions, process owners and functional teams.
Build data literacy and AI adoption through playbooks, coaching, training and practical examples.
Recruit, develop and retain a high-performing team across data engineering, analytics, data governance, data science, AI engineering and business analysis.

Operations, Budget and Performance

Manage the Data & AI budget, vendor relationships, platform consumption and licensing in line with value delivered.
Implement portfolio reporting on delivery velocity, adoption, value, risks, data quality and operational performance.
Ensure production AI and data capabilities have clear ownership, lifecycle management, monitoring, support and continuous improvement.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, AI, digital product delivery or related technology leadership roles.
Proven track record delivering AI, analytics or data products into production, not only strategy or governance frameworks.
Strong working knowledge of data architecture, cloud data platforms, data warehousing, analytics engineering, data governance and information security.
Practical understanding of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG patterns, ML lifecycle, model governance and responsible AI concepts.
Ability to lead mixed teams of data engineers, BI/analytics developers, data scientists, AI engineers, business analysts and governance specialists.
Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to translate technical topics into business value, risk and investment decisions.
Hands-on technologist with builder mentality
Business translator with change management attitude
Governance-minded enabler
Fluent in English
Additional language skills considered an asset


Strongly Preferred:

Experience with Microsoft ecosystem including Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Copilot Studio and M365 Copilot.
Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, aftermarket, supply chain or complex B2B environments.
Experience building or operating an AI Center of Excellence, data office, analytics CoE or hub-and-spoke delivery model.
Good understanding of ITGC, SOX-style controls, cybersecurity, privacy and compliance expectations in enterprise environments.
Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines, MLOps, automation and modern software delivery practices.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

title: Job på Malta - Vil du arbejde med administrativ kundeservice med Igaming? - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
description:

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.

Employee benefits

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Wil jij aan de slag bij een informele woningcorporatie en € 19,61 per uur verdienen? Word parttime helpdeskmedewerker in Hilversum.
Wat ga je doen?
Als parttime helpdeskmedewerker ben jij het belangrijkste aanspreekpunt voor de huurders van sociale huurwoning van de Alliantie in Hilversum. Dankzij jouw inzet ervaren bewoners een prettig en zorgeloos woonproces. Of iemand nu belt over beschikbare woningen, een storing in huis of vragen heeft over betalingen. Je bent enthousiast, communicatief vaardig en weet goed om te gaan met verschillende emoties. Je denkt graag mee in oplossingen en vindt het belangrijk dat huurders zich gehoord voelen. Klantvriendelijkheid zit bij jou in de kern en je helpt mensen met plezier verder.

Eltra Engineering is toeleverancier voor de machinebouw en industrie. Eltra ontwerpt, installeert en onderhoudt productie- en procesautomatiseringsinstallaties. Voor de industriële eindklant worden gebouwinstallaties en IT-systemen aangelegd en beheerd. Ons team bestaat uit ongeveer 60 collega's. We typeren ons als een gemoedelijk bedrijf met korte lijnen. Eltra is gevestigd in een modern pand aan de A58 in Tilburg. Wij zijn ambitieus en groeiende. Dat maakt dat we uitbreiding zoeken voor ons enthousiaste team.
Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?
Je start je dag met een lopend project bij een van onze klanten op locatie. Dit betreft een nieuwe machine waarbij jij je bezig houdt met het bekabelen en aansluiten van een nieuwe machinelijn. De tekening komt niet altijd overeen met de werkelijkheid, waardoor er altijd kleine aanpassingen nodig zijn. Dit vraagt wat van jouw inzicht en inventiviteit. Nadat het bekabelen en aansluiten volledig is afgerond loop je tijdens het testen tegen een uitdaging aan. De band loopt niet zoals het hoort. Samen met een collega software engineer bekijken jullie welke aanpassingen er in de plc besturing gedaan moeten worden. Na deze aanpassingen testen jullie opnieuw en nu loopt de machinelijn goed. Tevreden kijk je naar de door jou aangesloten machine. Je hebt weer een mooie samenwerking afgrond samen met jouw projectteam.
