title: Engineering Manager - PureBallast
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the world? We do. It's the reason Alfa Laval and Wallenius water have developed Alfa Laval PureBallast - a system to treat ballast water and prevent invasive species from spreading between marine ecosystems. We have had a market leading position since the launch in 2006, and we sell systems to ship owners and shipyards worldwide. We are in a very fast-paced market driven by environmental legislation. Now we are looking for an Engineering Manager who wants to help us make a difference in the world.



Who are you?

You are a business-minded leader with a passion for technology and innovation. Analytical, process-oriented, and conscientious, you strive to exceed expectations and inspire those around you. You empower your team, foster collaboration, and actively contribute to their development. Your strong communication skills and relationship-building abilities enable you to work effectively across departments and with external stakeholders.





About the job

As Engineering Manager, you will lead and motivate a team of highly skilled design engineers, driving product development and product care for the PureBallast system.



Key responsibilities:

    

Lead, inspire, and develop the engineering team in product development and product care projects.

    

Ensure all new designs comply with applicable standards and regulations (IMO, USCG, Class, ISO, and internal requirements).

    

Provide technical support and verification for new designs.

    

Support supply chain and purchasing activities.

    

Drive and implement technical innovations.

    

Oversee resource planning, recruitment, and daily operations of the team.

    

Serve as a member of the R&D Management team.



This position is based in Flemingsberg, Stockholm and you can expect up to 15 days of travel annually.



What you know

    

University degree in Engineering or a related field provides a solid foundation for understanding technical aspects of the role.

    

5+ years of experience in leading teams of highly skilled specialists.

    

Experience of product development processes.

    

Experience from maritime industry is a merit.

    

Experience of explosion proof design is a merit.

    

Fluent in Swedish and English is a requirement.



What's in it for you?

We offer a challenging position in an open and friendly environment, where you will have the possibility to impact on the maritime environment. You will be part of a highly motivated R&D team where we help each other to develop and create value.

The PureBallast product is marketed and sold entirely by Alfa Laval, and you will act within the global Alfa Laval organization, with many international contacts, both internally and externally.



You will be employed by AlfaWall AB.

title: Consumer Engagement & Activation Specialist
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke-free future as a Consumer Engagement & Activation Specialist!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

In the Nordic region, we are 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.

Role summary:

This role will deliver, support and execute on set annual event plans based on Sweden specific Legal Age Meeting Point (LAMP) & Event objectives. You will also secure strong brand and consumer engagement events and activation in own channels and events/festivals where the brands are present. The role is securing brand growth/equity and consumers’ brand perception (awareness, understanding, engagement, likeability).

This role will require work outside of standard office hours and include some weekends.



Please note that this is a fixed term position until end of May 2027 (with the possibility of extension).



What You’ll Do:

• Support and execute event activities based on annual event plan and contribute to the full omni-channel strategy and find ways to further optimize the plan.

• Supervise events and coordinate potential 3rd party.

• Collaborate with service providers/vendors and manage the quality of provided services.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with agencies and ensure the brand identity is successfully translated across all creative work. Provide clear briefs, budgets, outlining strategy, the scope of assignments and project timelines.

• Budget and service order management for local market and individual projects.

• Through collaboration with other teams generate insights, information in order to improve brand appeal, marketing effectiveness and brand volume & share performance.

• Ensure that all events and activities are in full compliance with local market regulations, the PMI Marketing code and business conduct policies and practices.

                                          

Skills & Capabilities

• A minimum of 3 years of experience with event management

• Strong networking and stakeholder management skills

• Proficiency in Swedish and English is required

• Possess a driver’s license (B)                              



Rewards & Benefits

Our success depends on the people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke free future.

title: Product Manager EMEA- Troax
description:
What happens when commercial insight, product strategy, and market understanding come together to shape the future of a business? As Product Manager EMEA, that challenge becomes part of everyday work.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of one of Troax's most strategically important product areas, influencing both current performance and future growth. By combining business acumen, analytical thinking, and stakeholder collaboration, the role helps ensure that Troax continues to deliver market-leading solutions to customers across Europe.

Your new team

Across Europe, teams at Troax work every day to create safer and more efficient environments for customers in manufacturing, warehousing, and intralogistics. Product Management plays a central role in that mission by translating customer needs, market trends, and business opportunities into competitive product offerings that create value for customers and drive profitable growth.

As part of the EMEA Product Management and R&D organization, close collaboration happens across Sales, Production, Marketing, Sourcing, Commercial Excellence, and global product functions. It’s a highly international environment where expertise, teamwork, and a shared ambition to improve continuously drive success.

About the job

As Product Manager EMEA, responsibility covers both the strategic and operational management of the portfolio across the EMEA region. The portfolio includes adjacent product categories. The role shapes the future offering by continuously evaluating the portfolio, identifying market opportunities, and driving product development initiatives that strengthen Troax’s customer value proposition. The product area represents a significant share of the company's business and plays a key role in Troax's continued development and profitability.

The position offers a balanced mix of strategic and operational responsibilities. Long-term portfolio planning, roadmap development, and future product initiatives are combined with pricing, commercial analysis, market intelligence, and daily support to the business. It is a broad commercial role with a strong influence on both product direction and business performance.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Managing and developing the EMEA product portfolio.

    

Driving the product roadmap and future product development initiatives.

    

Defining pricing strategies and supporting commercial growth through data-driven decision-making.

    

Conducting financial, market, competitor, and customer analyses to identify opportunities and support business decisions.

A high degree of ownership comes with the role. Day-to-day portfolio decisions, pricing activities, and business analyses are managed independently, while larger product and portfolio decisions are aligned through the wider product management organization. Success depends on the ability to influence stakeholders, build alignment, and drive progress in a matrix environment without formal people management responsibility.

Based in Jönköping or Hillerstorp, Värnamo, this role offers the opportunity to work at the center of Troax’s EMEA Product Management organization while collaborating with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders across Europe. The role includes regular international interaction throughout the EMEA region and travel for customer visits, trade fairs, training sessions, and sales conferences. The position reports to the Product Management & R&D Director EMEA.

Profile

A relevant academic background in Engineering or Business provides a solid foundation for the role. Experience from product management, category management, business development, product marketing, strategic pricing, or a similar commercially oriented position is highly relevant. Experience from manufacturing, warehousing, material handling, intralogistics, or other industrial B2B environments is advantageous. Strong analytical capability and business understanding are important, together with the ability to translate market insights into profitable business decisions. Fluency in English and the ability to communicate effectively across functions, cultures, and organizational levels are essential.

Commercial curiosity, ownership, and energy create success in this role. Building trust across functions comes naturally, and complex discussions are navigated with confidence, clarity, and respect. Strong stakeholder management skills help drive decisions and create momentum even without formal authority. A proactive mindset, combined with sound judgment and a genuine interest in customers and business development, enables long-term impact in a dynamic international environment.

Why Join Troax?

At Troax, you’ll join a global market leader with a strong growth agenda and a clear purpose: creating safer workplaces around the world. This is an opportunity to influence the future of an important product portfolio, work in a collaborative international environment, and contribute directly to business performance and innovation. Along the way, you’ll be supported by committed colleagues, a strong company culture, and a business that values initiative, expertise, and continuous development.

How to apply

If this opportunity sounds right for you, we look forward to hearing from you.

We are partnering with Gruffman Recruitment & Consulting in this recruitment process. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, no later than Sept 15. For questions about the role, contact Ulrika Gruffman at ulrika@gruffman.nu.

Troax is the global leader in mesh panel safety solutions - and we’re passionate about creating safer workplaces around the world. Founded in Sweden and now active in over 40 countries, we help customers protect people, machinery, and property through smart, reliable solutions for machine guarding, warehouse partitioning, and property protection.

Our growth continues strong: in 2025, sales totaled approximately €261 million, and we are now about 1,600 employees working together to drive innovation, quality, and customer value. Join a company with a friendly culture, a forward-thinking mindset, and the ambition to make a real difference.

Learn more: www.troax.com

title: Network-Focused Cloud Engineer
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Job Description

Do you find satisfaction in understanding how your technical expertise enables our business applications and by that be able to Power Climate Smarter Living?

We need to strengthen our cloud operations team with an additional colleague who is driven by technical challenges and the urge to always find better and more efficient ways of delivering services to the customer.

The Digital Platform Operation Team is a multi-competence Team, operating the Vattenfall Digital Platform; this comes with a big variety of tasks to ensure stable cloud systems. Those tasks are governance (ensuring architectural and security compliance), IaaS, PaaS, Network operation, Monitoring support, Azure DevOps support and capacity management. To handle all those different topics we must automate as much as possible and provide self-service functionality.

Your responsibilities:

As our Cloud Engineer your major responsible for ensuring a stable cloud platform which is evolving with the needs of the organization.

Specific tasks would include:

    Cloud Networking
    Understanding Cloud-onPrem connectivity (ExpressRoute, MPLS, BGP)
    Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based network architectures (e.g., VPCs, subnets, routing, paas specific subnet creation, network Segmentation, private endpoints).
    Collaborate with DevOps, security, and development teams to integrate networking solutions.
    Automate network infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like PowerShell, Bicep / Arm.
    Monitor and troubleshoot network performance issues in cloud environments.
    Knowledge in designing and operating Next Gen Firewall Environments, ideally Check Point.
    Scripting
    Writing scripts in Powershell, Bash
    Automation and orchestration
    Creating and maintaining automation based on scripts using e.g. REST
    Configuration Management
    Using tools like ARM templates, Bicep but also Ansible or DSC
    OS support
    Troubleshooting OS issues with Windows and Linux
    Governance
    Ensuring proper usage of tagging, permission handling, naming and policies
    Support platform audits
    Financial analyses
    Having a good understanding of the cloud financial model and the TCO
    Giving advice on cloud consumption
    Security
    Manage and react on alerts from Azure Security Center
    Guiding projects together with IT security for secure implementation
    Source Code Management (Azure DevOps)
    Manage Azure DevOps (create project rooms, licenses management, feature enablement)
    Backlog handling

Location  

Stockholm, Amsterdam, Berlin or Katowice

Qualifications

Your profile

In the role as Cloud Engineer with the focus on Network you will be working in a team that is very close to business but also to Agile IT and Core IT. To succeed in this role it is important that you have the ability to get an T-shaped skill profile. Whereas it is expected you are an expert on Network in Cloud environments. However do also have a basic understanding of OS, Backup, Security, Databases, Web, Azure Paas Services to still be the a generalist we are looking for. So there is not one person dealing e.g. with Network it is the whole team. Since automation is key for our delivery, you are also expected to have the ability to code and/or script. You need to be able to let go of traditional way of working and be open for a fast changing and developing environment.

You are not only an expert technician but you also have social competence and understands the need of the business. You always challenge yourself and others how to improve and develop and are open for suggestions from others but can also give your own.

As Cloud Engineer you dispose of the following qualifications and skills:

    An academic Degree in IT, engineering, science or mathematics
    Interested in new technologies and a fast learner
    Experience with cloud services
    Experience in a large international environment
    Experience in troubleshooting and root cause analysis
    Be able to work under pressure
    Ability to translate complicated technical matters into simple understandable language
    A broad and versatile profile with one or several areas of deeper technical knowledge

We are looking for a specialist who is willing to develop to a T-Shaped Cloud Specialist and has a background in network.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than, 27th of September 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the role, please contact the Hiring Manager Daniël van der Vliet: daniel.van.der.vliet@vattenfall.com for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de).

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.



We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Medical oncologist for a modern oncology department in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a specialist in medical oncology looking for a role that combines professional development, multidisciplinary collaboration, and access to modern cancer treatments?

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established oncology department in Sweden that provides comprehensive cancer care across a broad spectrum of diagnoses. You will join an experienced and supportive team where collaboration, clinical excellence and continuous development are highly valued.

This is an opportunity to work in a specialty that is constantly evolving, with access to modern therapies and the possibility to contribute to the ongoing development of cancer care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

About the role

As a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:

    Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.
    Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.
    Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).
    Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.
    Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.
    Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.
    Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.

Why this opportunity?

    

Collaborative and supportive environment:

Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

    

Modern oncology practice:

Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

    

Professional development:

Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

    

Varied clinical work:

Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

    

Long-term career opportunities:

Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden

The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.

Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.

Requirements

    EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.
    Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.
    Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.
    Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.
    Strong communication skills in English.
    Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.

Why Choose Dignus Medical?

We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.

What Dignus Medical offers you:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Interested in a career in Sweden?

Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: IT Security Specialist to Bonava in Stockholm
description:
Lead and develop IT security at Bonava in Stockholm. Work with Azure, Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity in a cloud-first environment

At Bonava, we are not only building houses, we are also creating homes and neighborhoods where people live their lives. To keep our digital world safe, we´re now looking for an IT Security Specialist to lead and develop our cybersecurity landscape.This is a broad role where you will combine strategic vision with hands-on expertise. You will work closely with colleagues across infrastructure, governance and operations to strengthen our security posture, drive continuous improvement and ensure our cloud-first environment remains secure, compliant and resilient.If you are motivated by taking ownership, influencing security strategies and working with modern Microsoft technologies in a business-critical environment, this is an opportunity to make a real impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

At Bonava, you will have the opportunity to shape how we protect our systems, services and data moving forward. You will join an organization where security is an important enabler for the business and where your expertise will influence both strategy and operations.

You will have the opportunity to:

    Take overall responsibility for IT security across Bonava
    Work in a cloud-first environment built primarily on Microsoft Azure
    Influence and develop security frameworks, processes and ways of working
    Combine strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical work
    Collaborate with stakeholders across IT and the wider business
    Enjoy a flexible hybrid working model from our central Stockholm office

Your Challenge

As IT Security Specialist, you will take overall responsibility for IT security at Bonava. This is a broad role where you will work closely with both technical teams and business stakeholders to continuously strengthen the organization’s security posture.

You will:

    Strengthen and maintain security across Bonava’s systems and data
    Monitor the threat landscape and initiate preventive measures
    Manage and develop security infrastructure
    Educate users and promote a strong security culture across the organization
    Drive improvement initiatives related to security and compliance
    Provide informed guidance to management on security risks, incidents and strategic priorities to enhance the organization’s security posture

The Team and Workplace

You will be part of the IT Infrastructure and Compliance team, working alongside colleagues within infrastructure, governance and operations.

Bonava operates with a cloud-first IT strategy, primarily leveraging Microsoft Azure. While the focus is on modern cloud-based solutions, the environment remains hybrid, with certain systems and services still managed on- premises.

The position is based in central Stockholm and offers a hybrid work model with flexibility to work from home.

About You

We believe you will thrive in this role if you have a few years of experience within IT Security or Infrastructure and enjoy working in an environment where strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving go hand in hand.

You also have:

    Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Security tools, like Defender, Intune and Sentinel
    Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, Intune and automation
    Understanding of Azure environments and hybrid setups
    Understanding of network security principles
     Experience working with enterprise network environments
    Skills in scripting, preferably PowerShell or Python
    A proactive, structured and responsible approach
    Excellent communication skills in English

As a person, you are collaborative and take initiative to move your work forward. You are a clear and confident communicator who builds trust with stakeholders across the organization. You exercise good judgement, stay up to date with developments in the cybersecurity landscape and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

It is considered a plus if you have experience working with governance, risk and compliance frameworks, as well as log management and analysis. Swedish language skills are also considered an advantage.

Let´s Connect!

We have chosen to work with Ada Digital in this hiring process. Their recruitment process focuses on transparency, inclusion and a fast moving candidate experience. And now we want to know more about you – on your own terms! To apply, please fill out the short form, briefly motivate why you are interested in the position, and attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile. No additional documentation is needed. You can then, in real-time, follow your application online as our recruiters are working with it. We work with a continues selection process which means we might hire a candidate before the final apply date, so apply already today! Interested and want to know more? Please contact our recruiter today.  We are looking forward to connecting soon!

title: Supporttekniker Service Desk
description:
Supporttekniker Service Desk

Vill du arbeta nära nätet som är den digitala ryggraden i samhället?Som Supporttekniker i Service Desk hos GlobalConnect är du med och säkerställer stabil och tillförlitlig kommunikation för GlobalConnects kunder – varje dag 24/7.

Rollen följer ett planerat skiftschema med rotation dygnet runt.

Arbetsuppgifter:

    Incidenthantering vid larm eller avbrott.
    Felsöka nätrelaterade ärenden så som svartfiber, WiFi, SD-WAN, routing, säkerhet med flera layer2 och 3 tjänster.
    Supportera kunder, koordinera med andra avdelningar och underleverantörer via ärendehanteringssystemet.
    Hantera eskalationer och dispatcha ärenden för jämn arbetsfördelning.
    Dokumentera och producera rapporter (RFO/RCA) vid större avbrott.
    Bidra till att förbättra rutiner och processer i Servicedesk.

Om rollen och teamet

I rollen som Supporttekniker får du en central roll i GlobalConnects vardag. Här jobbar du mitt i hjärtat av vår nätverksamhet med att se till att våra största kunder inom B2B alltid får tillgång till stabil och snabb service. Du felsöker, supportar och dokumenterar ofta under tidspress och blir en viktig del i att hålla våra samhällskritiska tjänster tillgängliga.

Tillsammans med kollegor i Servicedesk hanterar du varierande ärenden, oavsett om det handlar om att svara på ett inkommande larm, lösa en teknisk incident eller skicka vidare ett ärende till rätt person. Du kommer oftast ha hjälp från en kollega under skiften, men det kan förekomma tillfällen där du arbetar själv.

Det här jobbet passar dig som gillar struktur, trivs med variation och vill bidra till att våra tjänster håller hög kvalitet, oavsett tid på dygnet. Ingen dag är den andra lik, men varje dag spelar roll för att se till att samhällskritiska funktioner fortsätter att fungera med hjälp av vår digitala infrastruktur.

Den här rollen är för dig som har:

    Relevant utbildning inom nätverk, gärna på högskolenivå.

    1–2 års erfarenhet från Service Desk, Help Desk eller liknande teknisk supportfunktion, gärna mot B2B segmentet.

    Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift för effektiv kommunikation med våra kunder. Danska och norska är också fördelaktigt om du har kunskap i då vi är en Nordisk organisation.

De tekniska krav som ställs i rollen är:

    Router och switchteknik, Huawei, Cisco. (CCNA Routing and Switching: Routing and Switching Essentials)
    Internetteknik (CCNA Routing and Switching: Introduction to Networks)
    Router- och switchteknik i skalbara nät (CCNA Routing and Switching: Scaling Networks)
    WAN-teknik (CCNA Routing and Switching: Connecting Networks)
    Switchteknik (CCNP R&S Switch: Implementing IP Switching)
    Nätverkstekniskfelsökning (CCNP R&S TSHOOT: Maintaining and Troubleshooting IP Networks)
    SD-WAN teknik: Fortinet, Versa
    Trådlösa nätverk: Aruba

Vem vi söker:

Vi söker dig som kommunicerar lugnt och tydligt, även när tempot är högt och flera ärenden behöver hanteras parallellt. Du har ett tydligt kundfokus, tar ansvar för dina ärenden och arbetar strukturerat för att leverera med hög kvalitet. Du har ett genuint intresse för nätverk, teknik och felsökning och trivs med att analysera problem och hitta lösningar. Samtidigt uppskattar du att samarbeta med andra och bidra till ett bra gemensamt resultat.

Varför GlobalConnect?

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team som arbetar med samhällskritisk digital infrastruktur där tillgänglighet, kvalitet och samarbete är avgörande. Från rollen som Supporttekniker finns det karriärvägar internt mot både djupare tekniska roller eller mot produkt- och säljroller. Om du vill ha en fot in till en karriär inom telco är det här en utmärkt möjlighet!

Rekryteringsprocessen

    Talent Acquisition Screeningintervju
    Intervju med rekryterande chef
    Tester - logiskt tänkande samt personlighetstest med uppföljande samtal med Talent Acquisition Partner
    Intervju med chef + teammedlem
    Referenstagning samt bakgrundskoll. Rollen kan komma att bli säkerhetsklassificerad i ett senare skede.

Praktisk information

title: Service Desk Specialist
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 5884



Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and directing Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank and its surrounding environment, enabling the Customer Vision and Business Strategy. We are looking for a Service Desk Specialist for a full-time position in the Specialised IT Services Team.

You will one out of two employees supporting out of Stockholm, but of course belong into the full team of Specialised IT services.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We are not just a bank; we are a technology employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth.

About our team

Meet the Specialised IT Services Team. We are a team of 11 specialist IT professionals delivering high-quality end-user IT support for Nordea Asset Management and Nordea Markets. Our role is to deliver first- and second-level IT support and participate in tasks and projects within our support areas and Group Technology. We operate in a highly sensitive, fast-paced banking environment, where proactive support, ownership, clear communication, and strong service quality is essential.

What you’ll be doing:

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you:

    Have strong attention to detail and understand the impact IT incidents can have on end users in a banking and trading environment.
    Enjoy working with people and can communicate clearly with traders, business users, internal technology teams and external vendors.
    Take ownership, follow up proactively and remain calm when supporting time-critical incidents.
    Have a structured approach to incident handling, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
    Are curious and willing to build new competences that improve the quality and speed of support.

Your background and skills include:

    Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows, operating systems, workplace applications, hardware, laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals.
    Know a bit of PowerShell.
    Basic knowledge on Network, VDI’s and Databases.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These values guide how we work and make decisions – and we imagine you share them with us.

You will join one of the largest Nordic banks, with opportunities to learn, develop, and work with skilled colleagues in a vibrant and diverse working environment. We believe in the value of bringing people together while embracing flexibility where possible. Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work, and we know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 11/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us. Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. title: Python Backend Engineer
description:
Quartr is a software company serving the world of finance. Every day, leading companies and financial institutions worldwide use our products to research faster and understand deeper.

For too long, markets have been obsessed with numbers. Everyone has access to the same quantitative data, while qualitative insights – the words, the signals, the nuance – have remained mostly in the shadows. We make those insights accessible, searchable, and actionable.

Our products are used daily by some of the most sophisticated teams in finance and tech, including major hedge funds and Magnificent 7 companies, and over a million finance professionals have downloaded our mobile app.

We're backed by some of the smartest minds in our industry and growing fast at a global scale, and we're still at the very beginning of what we expect to be a multi-decade journey.

We are looking for a Python Backend Engineer to play a key role in scaling and improving our transcripts pipelines. If you love engineering robust software, extracting information from text, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you!

Our transcripts team builds and maintains the pipelines that power one of Quartr's most important data assets: transcripts. Your work will provide the core data foundation that powers essential product features and drives future product development.

What you'll do

    Build scalable systems for transcript ingestion, processing, and enrichment from diverse text sources
    Optimise backend performance for high-volume, text-heavy workloads and parallel processing
    Work on text processing and information extraction: entity recognition, metadata enrichment, and semantic structuring of transcripts
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape features from concept to release, ensuring outstanding user experiences
    Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure smooth operation and timely data delivery

Who you are

    Self-driven, proactive, and confident in taking full ownership of projects
    

    A keen interest in NLP, speech-to-text, or large-scale text pipelines is advantageous
    Comfortable learning new technologies and eager to improve products and processes
    Balance pragmatism and craftsmanship, knowing when to move quickly and when to build for long-term scalability - even in complex systems with many interdependent components
    Communicate clearly and effectively, thriving in a high-paced, collaborative environment
    

    Based in Sweden with a valid work permit

Required skills

    3+ years of professional experience building robust backends in Python, preferably for large-scale or data-intensive systems
    Proven experience developing and maintaining REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
    Familiarity with asynchronous programming and distributed processing
    

    Ability to explain code and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    Ability to propose durable, simple solutions to complex problems

What we offer

    Do your life's work: The world's leading finance professionals use Quartr daily. We do fewer things better and hold a very high bar for quality.
    

    Join the foundational team: We're still at the very beginning of a multi-decade journey. You'll have a big influence on product, culture, and how we win.
    

    Meritocracy over hierarchy: You'll join a culture where the best idea wins. We value clear thinking, leave ego at the door, and obsess over the details.
    

    Office culture with flexibility: Join us in one of our offices. We value being together, while also offering the flexibility to work from home when needed.
    

    Compensation & well-being: We offer competitive salaries, benefits, and a generous wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health.

We include occupational pension for all employees in Sweden.

You enjoy combining technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and take ownership of your work from concept to delivery. Strong communication skills, problem-solving ability, and a structured approach will help you succeed in a role that involves close interaction with colleagues across engineering, production, and project teams. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve products and processes.

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

You will join one of four engineering teams consisting of approximately 60 engineers working on world-leading tissue machine technology. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific machine sections and components, becoming a key technical expert within your area. The role provides close collaboration with production and pre-assembly teams, giving you a valuable end-to-end understanding of the products you help create.

At Valmet, you'll work in an international and people-focused environment where innovation, sustainability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do. We value continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and a supportive culture where your ideas and contributions matter.

Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection

- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint
- Erfahrung mit PowerShell-Skripting oder anderen Automatisierungssprachen
- Verständnis für IT-Security-Prinzipien (MFA, Zero Trust, Endpoint Protection, Backup-Strategien)
- Grundverständnis für APIs, Webhooks und JSON zur Integration von Systemen
- Erfahrung mit oder starkes Interesse an Generativer KI, LLMs, RAG-Konzepten und Prompt-Optimierung
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Adyen oder vergleichbaren SaaS-Plattformen

Persönliche Stärken

- Neugier und Innovationsfreude, insbesondere im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung

Sprachen

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Kaiseraugst sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Entzugsstation.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Kaiseraugst: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplompflegefachfrauen und -fachleute HF/FH in der Entzugsbehandlung rund um Kaiseraugst im Aargau ist geprägt von anhaltender hoher Nachfrage, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem anspruchsvollen Bereich knapp sind. Sie haben als qualifizierte Fachperson ausgezeichnete Chancen auf eine schnelle Anstellung in etablierten Fachkliniken und Rehabilitationszentren der Region. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich, indem wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern verbinden, umfassend bei der Bewerbung unterstützen und Ihre Fachkompetenz optimal positionieren.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Opfikon

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Opfikon liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Flughafen Zürich und verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung durch die S-Bahn und Autobahnanschlüsse. Sie finden hier eine dynamische Wirtschaftsregion mit vielen Unternehmen aus Logistik, Dienstleistung und Industrie. Die zentrale Lage zwischen Zürich und Glatttal macht Opfikon zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort mit guter Erreichbarkeit für Pendler aus der ganzen Region.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Opfikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Opfikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Opfikon im Kanton Zürich besteht eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen für Akutspitäler, da der Fachkräftemangel in diesem Bereich weiterhin akut ist. Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau oder -mann HF/FH haben ausgezeichnete Chancen auf attraktive Positionen mit flexiblen Pensumsmodellen, die sich Ihren persönlichen Anforderungen anpassen lassen. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch gezielte Vermittlung in renommierte Spitäler der Region und kompetente Unterstützung bei der Stellensuche.

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

title: Un-e Assistant-e social-e  en CDI
description:
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e (100%) en CDI  
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e (100%) en CDI \- EVAM  
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e (100%) en CDI  
Rejoignez l'EVAM et donnez du sens à votre expertise !  
Et si votre prochain défi professionnel avait un réel impact social ?  
À l'EVAM, chaque collaborateur\-trice contribue à une mission essentielle : accompagner des personnes en situation de migration avec ouverture et responsabilité.  
Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recrutons :  
Un\-e Assistant\-e social\-e en antenne en CDI à 100%  
Lieu : Lausanne  
Entrée en fonction : A convenir  
Le mot de votre futur responsable, Cécile :  
« Notre structure accompagne depuis plusieurs années les personnes migrantes dans leur parcours d'intégration, avec humanité, professionnalisme et engagement.  
Chaque journée est différente : accompagnement social et administratif, accès aux droits, coordination avec nos partenaires\- un travail riche et porteur de sens.  
Vous rejoindrez une équipe pluridisciplinaire et solidaire, où entraide et partage d'expérience sont essentiels.  
Nous cherchons une personne motivée, prête à s'engager pour la et le respect de la dignité humaine.  
Au plaisir de faire votre connaissance ».  
Vos missions clés  
Vous êtes en charge du suivi administratif et entretiens sociaux.  
Vous mettez en place un plan d'action personnalisés.  
Vous soutenez les bénéficiaires dans l'intégration sociale, professionnelle et administrative.  
Vous coordonnez avec les partenaires internes et externes.  
Vous veillez à apporter une expertise et des conseils au guichet social cantonal pour garantir un accompagnement de qualité  
Votre profil  
Vous avez bachelor HES en travail social (reconnaissance SEFRI si diplôme étranger).  
Minimum. 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire.  
Vous avez une bonne connaissance du réseau vaudois et des assurances sociales.  
Vous avez un Français excellent (oral et écrit) ; la maîtrise de l'anglais ou d'autres langues est un atout  
Vous avez un Intérêt marqué pour le domaine de la migration.  
Ce que l'EVAM vous propose  
Un environnement de travail engagé  
5 semaines de vacances (6 dès 50 ans)  
De très bonnes prestations sociales  
Des projets porteurs de sens dans un contexte interculturel stimulant  
Le processus de recrutement en 3 étapes :  
1\. Un entretien avec le responsable d'antenne et la chargée de recrutement.  
2\. Une mise en situation  
3\. Une demi\-journée d'immersion pour découvrir concrètement votre futur environnement de travail.  
À l'issue du processus : demande d'un extrait du casier judiciaire (documents vierges requis).  
Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette mission ?

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action

Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.
